podcast.title: Formation and Lineup
podcast.body: The Melody Makers were formed in 1979 by Bob Marley's children: David (Ziggy), Steven, Sadella, and Sharon Marley. Their song "Tomorrow People" featured Ziggy, his mother Rita, and his sisters Sadella and Sharon, along with his brother Stephen. "The Melody Makers were formed by siblings David, better known as Ziggy, Steven, Sadella, and Sharon back in 1979."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Matriarch and Performer
xref.body: Rita Marley is the mother of several of Bob Marley's musical children and performed with the Melody Makers, including on their hit song "Tomorrow People." "It features Ziggy, Mother Rita, Sisters Sadella, and Sharon and Brother Stephen."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
